text:
Kai: heads-up — planning a small canary tonight for quant-batching changes. target window 02:00-03:00 UTC, rolling percentages (0.5 -> 5 -> 25 -> 100). Priya: I'm the deploy owner, will run smoke and monitor. Sam: I can watch dashboards and take pager for the window. Marta: i'll own rollback decision and post-mortem if needed.

Priya: rough cadence: 5m wait at 0.5%, 10m at 5%, 15m at 25% then final cutover. we want graceful KV cache warmup between ramps. Kai: cohort order — NA-east (0.5), NA-west+EU (5), global (25). keep APAC out of first pass.

Sam: what are the smoke pass criteria? short checklist pls.

Priya: smoke checklist (short):
1) all canary pods Ready==1 and no CrashLoopBackOff
2) p50/p95 latency below baselines (p95 < 350ms)
3) error rate < 0.3% (5xx/token errors)
4) KV cache hit ratio not regress > 5% from baseline
5) no new schema/warnings in logs (grep for "Schema mismatch" / "Unhandled exception")

Marta: add operator thresholds: auto-rollback if error rate > 0.8% or p95 > 500ms for two consecutive windows. manual rollback toggle if we see increased hallucinations in eval set.

Priya: deploy plan snippet (commands i'll run):

```
# kick off canary
./deploy/run.sh --env=prod --strategy=canary --config=canary/quant-batching.yaml
# ramp helper (local)
./tools/ramp --plan canary/quant-plan.json
```

Expected quick check outputs: "All pods are Ready", "KV hit=0.72", "p95=320ms", "errors=0.12%". If any missing, abort.

Sam: I'll watch these metrics and post short updates. please @mention me when you start the 0.5% step.

Kai: deploy-bot scheduled the window. deploy-bot: canary job queued for 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z.

Priya: infra ask — can someone pre-warm the GPU pool 30m before start? warms the runtime kernels and avoids cold-cache spikes.

Kai: @Marta can you confirm rollback playbook is up-to-date and accessible?

Marta: confirmed — rollback doc updated, steps below. quick rollback commands: 

```
# rollback to previous stable
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-serving
./scripts/cancel-prefetch-caches.sh
# notify downstream
./notify/team --channel=prod-alerts --msg="rolled back quant-batching canary"
```

Marta: note — if we rollback, preserve logs and core KV snapshot (don't delete). I'll collect traces for root cause.

Priya: will post post-deploy smoke command and paste expected outputs here 10m before start. Sam: thanks for taking pager. Kai: i'll coordinate cohort gating if any region shows signals.

Sam: one last ask — who will own DB migrations if any?

Priya: no schema migrations in this change. all config-only.

Kai: small reminder: keep the rollout timed so that on-call rotations are covered (avoid 02:00 -> 04:00 local transitions).

Priya: starting pre-warm at 01:30 UTC, will ping here when it's done.

deploy-bot: pre-warm job started: gpu-pool/prewarm-quant-01 (ETA ~18m).

Sam: :thumbsup: added brief dashboard links: https://dashboards.redwood/infra/canary and infra-alerts filter.

Priya: smoke command (posting now):

```
# smoke script
./smoke/canary_health_check.sh --target canary --samples 50
# expected output (one-liners)
# PODS READY: 5/5\n# KV_HIT: 0.70\n# P50: 110ms P95: 320ms\n# ERR_RATE: 0.12%\n```

Priya: if smoke script shows ERR_RATE > 0.3% or P95 > 400ms — abort and roll back.

Marta: i'll be on standby at the start and will call rollback within 5m of a failing condition.

Kai: thanks team — i'll update the release doc and mark owners. ping me if you need additional infra creds.

Priya: LGTM from code review side, logs scrubbed. starting warm-up in 8m.

Sam: watching dashboards now; will post updates as we move through ramps.

deploy-bot: canary run started at 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Job id: cb-4456789123.

Priya: 02:05 UTC — 0.5% step complete, smoke ok: PODS READY 5/5, KV_HIT=0.71, P95=310ms, ERR=0.09%. moving to 5%.

Sam: observed small p95 bump to 330ms during 5% ramp, but within threshold. KV hit improving.

Marta: still green from my side. continue.

Priya: 02:20 UTC — 5% step stable. advancing to 25%.

Sam: monitoring p95 and errors closely. will escalate if errors trend upward.

Priya: final cutover to 100% planned after 15m stable at 25%.

Marta: if anything spikes during 25% -> 100%, we will pause and roll back to previous stable.

Sam: noted. posting a brief debrief after window.

Kai: great run — thanks everyone. saved runbook notes to release doc and flagged metrics for follow-up.
